entries.title: Isaiah 54:1
segments: ¶Exult, thou barren, that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and shout for joy, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:2
segments: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thy habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:3
segments: For thou shalt spread abroad on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall possess nations, and they shall make desolate cities to be inhabited.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:4
segments: Fear not, for thou shalt not be ashamed; neither be thou confounded, for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:5
segments: For thy Maker is thy husband: Jehovah of hosts is his name, and thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: the God of the whole earth shall he be called.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:6
segments: ¶For Jehovah hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and as a wife of youth, that hath been refused, saith thy God.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:7
segments: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:8
segments: In the outpouring of wrath have I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting loving-kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:9
segments: For this is [as] the waters of Noah unto me, since I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth: so have I sworn that I will no more be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:10
segments: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my loving-kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall my covenant of peace be removed, saith Jehovah, that hath mercy on thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:11
segments: ¶[Thou] afflicted, tossed with tempest, not comforted! Behold, I will set thy stones in antimony, and lay thy foundations with sapphires;

entries.title: Isaiah 54:12
segments: and I will make thy battlements of rubies, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of precious stones.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:13
segments: And all thy children [shall be] taught of Jehovah, and great shall be the peace of thy children.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:14
segments: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression, for thou shalt not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:15
segments: Behold, they shall surely gather together, [but] not by me: whosoever gathereth together against thee shall fall because of thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:16
segments: Behold, it is I who have created the smith that bloweth in the fire of coal, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the destroyer to ravage.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:17
segments: No weapon that is prepared against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that riseth against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the inheritance of the servants of Jehovah; and their righteousness is of me, saith Jehovah.
